gitCommit.subject: test(coverage): Phase 3 — rationalize 25 mocked route siblings (convert-then-delete; floor 70→73) (#233)
gitCommit.body:
test(coverage): Phase 3 — rationalize 25 mocked route siblings (convert-then-delete; floor 70→73) (#233)

* test(sessions): real-DB integration for sessions routes; drop mocked siblings (Phase 3)

Convert the three mocked sessions route siblings to one honest real-DB
integration file driving the real handlers -> SessionController ->
SessionRepository -> ephemeral Postgres (mock only getSession + getDb).

- Create src/lib/db/sessions-routes.integration.test.ts (18 tests):
  POST /api/sessions and /api/sessions/[id] GET/PATCH/DELETE, full authz
  matrix (401/400/403/404 + happy with real DB-state read-backs, non-vacuous
  guards), curator-scope per purses-t9l.
- Close the decisions branch gap in triage-decision.integration.test.ts
  (cases D/E/F: 401, 404 absent session, 500 NOT NULL write failure).
- Delete the mocked siblings: sessions/route.test.ts,
  sessions/[id]/route.test.ts, sessions/[id]/decisions/route.test.ts.

No product code changed; no authz gaps found (no beads filed).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(items): real-DB integration for collection-items + items/[id]; drop mocked siblings (Phase 3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(invitations): real-DB integration for collection invitations; drop mocked sibling (Phase 3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(members): real-DB integration for member management; drop mocked sibling (Phase 3)

GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/collections/[id]/members/[mid] driven through the real
handler -> requireApiCollectionAccess + MemberController -> MembershipRepository
-> ephemeral Postgres. Mocks only getSession + getDb. Full authz matrix
(401/403/404/happy) + belongs-to-parent 404 (foreign-collection membership) +
DB-state read-backs (PATCH flag mutation persists; DELETE present-before/gone-after).
Pins the owner-only manager gate (isCollectionManager ignores canManageCollection;
purses-lgql, pv9 epic). Deletes the heavily-mocked route.test.ts sibling.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(photos): real-DB integration for item-photo routes (blob-mock); drop mocked siblings (Phase 3)

Convert-then-delete for the four item-photo route siblings. New
src/lib/db/item-photo-routes.integration.test.ts drives the real POST upload /
PATCH rotate / DELETE / set-hero handlers -> repos -> ephemeral Postgres, mocking
only getSession, getDb, and @vercel/blob (put/del asserted with the right args).
Extends file-route-authz.integration.test.ts to close the /file branch gap
(401, photo belongs-to-parent 404, non-owner member 200) and moves the
@vitest-environment node pragma to line 1. Integration coverage of the four
route.ts: 96% lines / 92.77% branches (remaining gaps are defensive catch blocks
the siblings never asserted). Deletes the four mocked route.test.ts siblings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(pool): real-DB integration for pool routes; keep upload token-gen unit; drop mocked siblings (Phase 3)

Convert the four DB-backed pool routes to honest real-DB integration tests
(src/lib/db/pool-routes.integration.test.ts), mocking only getSession, getDb,
and @vercel/blob `get` (only the /file route touches blob; group/reassign hit
repos only). Covers the full authz matrix (401/403/404), route-specific 400s,
and happy paths with real DB read-backs:
 - pool/photos GET: lists ONLY itemId===null photos (assigned excluded)
 - pool/group POST: new item created, named photos repointed (combine + each)
 - photos/reassign POST: photos' itemId updated (pool / item / new)
 - pool/photos/[photoId]/file GET: 404 for an assigned photo; serves a pooled one

Coverage of the four handlers: 96.7% lines / 94.2% branches (was 0% DB-alone).
Trim pool/upload/route.test.ts to token-gen + authz unit cases (it writes no DB
row in the request path) and delete the four mocked siblings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort-results): cover happy/error branches; drop 9 mocked siblings (Phase 3)

Phase 3 Task 7: replace the 9 heavily-mocked sort-results route.test.ts siblings
with one honest real-DB integration file covering the happy + error/state-guard
branches that sort-results-authz (authz/IDOR/belongs-to-parent) and sort-pipeline
(materialization, [id] PATCH/DELETE 409, items DELETE, service-level supersede)
did not execute:

  - [id] GET happy
  - finalize POST happy (draft -> finalized, persisted) + pinned no-state-guard
  - items GET happy (computed-rank order)
  - items/[rid] GET/PATCH happy, 409 finalized, 400 invalid-JSON, pinned 500 bad-enum
  - items/[rid]/reset happy (override cleared) + 409 finalized
  - shares POST happy + 400 invalid-JSON
  - shares/[sid] GET/PATCH/DELETE happy + 400 invalid-JSON
  - supersede POST FULL: 401/403/404/409-state-guard + happy clone-through-route

Handler -> controller/service -> repo -> ephemeral Postgres; mocks only auth + db.
Pinned (not fixed) behaviors filed as purses-ydph: finalize is idempotent (no 409),
and PATCH/POST validation ZodErrors surface as 500 not 400.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort-results): add POST-create 400 validation cases (review fix)

Phase 3 Task 7 deleted the mocked sibling route.test.ts, orphaning the two
POST-create 400 validation branches (missing collectionId / missing name).
Re-cover them in the integration tier via the real POST handler: each fires
before any DB write and is paired with a findByCollection read proving no
sort_results row landed (non-vacuous).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(members): move @vitest-environment directive to line 1 (review fix)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(coverage): ratchet merged floor 70->73 after Phase 3 sibling rationalization

Phase 3 converted 24 mocked route.test.ts siblings to real-DB integration
(mock only getSession + @vercel/blob) and deleted them; kept pool/upload as a
trimmed token-gen unit. Merged (union) coverage rose 71.52% -> 73.14% lines,
so the floor moves to 73. Honest coverage up; mocked unit tests that hid authz
gaps are gone. Plan + ledger included.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test: move @vitest-environment directive to line 1 across remaining Phase 3 files (review fix)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(architecture): coverage floor 70->73, Phase 3 merged 73.14% (sync-docs)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(graphify): refresh code graph after Phase 3 test rationalization

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

integration file driving the real handlers -> SessionController ->
SessionRepository -> ephemeral Postgres (mock only getSession + getDb).

- Create src/lib/db/sessions-routes.integration.test.ts (18 tests):
  POST /api/sessions and /api/sessions/[id] GET/PATCH/DELETE, full authz
  matrix (401/400/403/404 + happy with real DB-state read-backs, non-vacuous
  guards), curator-scope per purses-t9l.
- Close the decisions branch gap in triage-decision.integration.test.ts
  (cases D/E/F: 401, 404 absent session, 500 NOT NULL write failure).
- Delete the mocked siblings: sessions/route.test.ts,
  sessions/[id]/route.test.ts, sessions/[id]/decisions/route.test.ts.

No product code changed; no authz gaps found (no beads filed).

-> ephemeral Postgres. Mocks only getSession + getDb. Full authz matrix
(401/403/404/happy) + belongs-to-parent 404 (foreign-collection membership) +
DB-state read-backs (PATCH flag mutation persists; DELETE present-before/gone-after).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Convert-then-delete for the four item-photo route siblings. New
src/lib/db/item-photo-routes.integration.test.ts drives the real POST upload /
PATCH rotate / DELETE / set-hero handlers -> repos -> ephemeral Postgres, mocking
only getSession, getDb, and @vercel/blob (put/del asserted with the right args).
Extends file-route-authz.integration.test.ts to close the /file branch gap
(401, photo belongs-to-parent 404, non-owner member 200) and moves the
@vitest-environment node pragma to line 1. Integration coverage of the four
route.ts: 96% lines / 92.77% branches (remaining gaps are defensive catch blocks
the siblings never asserted). Deletes the four mocked route.test.ts siblings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(pool): real-DB integration for pool routes; keep upload token-gen unit; drop mocked siblings (Phase 3)

Convert the four DB-backed pool routes to honest real-DB integration tests
(src/lib/db/pool-routes.integration.test.ts), mocking only getSession, getDb,
and @vercel/blob `get` (only the /file route touches blob; group/reassign hit
repos only). Covers the full authz matrix (401/403/404), route-specific 400s,
and happy paths with real DB read-backs:
 - pool/photos GET: lists ONLY itemId===null photos (assigned excluded)
 - pool/group POST: new item created, named photos repointed (combine + each)
 - photos/reassign POST: photos' itemId updated (pool / item / new)
 - pool/photos/[photoId]/file GET: 404 for an assigned photo; serves a pooled one

Coverage of the four handlers: 96.7% lines / 94.2% branches (was 0% DB-alone).
Trim pool/upload/route.test.ts to token-gen + authz unit cases (it writes no DB
row in the request path) and delete the four mocked siblings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort-results): cover happy/error branches; drop 9 mocked siblings (Phase 3)

Phase 3 Task 7: replace the 9 heavily-mocked sort-results route.test.ts siblings
with one honest real-DB integration file covering the happy + error/state-guard
branches that sort-results-authz (authz/IDOR/belongs-to-parent) and sort-pipeline
(materialization, [id] PATCH/DELETE 409, items DELETE, service-level supersede)
did not execute:

  - [id] GET happy
  - finalize POST happy (draft -> finalized, persisted) + pinned no-state-guard
  - items GET happy (computed-rank order)
  - items/[rid] GET/PATCH happy, 409 finalized, 400 invalid-JSON, pinned 500 bad-enum
  - items/[rid]/reset happy (override cleared) + 409 finalized
  - shares POST happy + 400 invalid-JSON
  - shares/[sid] GET/PATCH/DELETE happy + 400 invalid-JSON
  - supersede POST FULL: 401/403/404/409-state-guard + happy clone-through-route

Handler -> controller/service -> repo -> ephemeral Postgres; mocks only auth + db.
Pinned (not fixed) behaviors filed as purses-ydph: finalize is idempotent (no 409),
and PATCH/POST validation ZodErrors surface as 500 not 400.
